extracted.name: Curried roast parsnips with cashews
extracted.description: Pair naturally sweet parsnips with bold Sri Lankan and Indian flavours and a dash of soy sauce. It takes parsnips to a whole new level of deliciousness
ingredient_lines: 500g parsnips (about 4), peeled, quartered and cut into chunks
1 tsp Sri Lankan or Madras curry powder
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 180C/160C fan/ gas 4 and roast the cashews on a baking tray with 1 tsp of the coconut oil and some salt for 8-10 mins until golden. Sprinkle with the chilli and set aside. Whisk all the dressing ingredients together and set aside.

Turn the oven up to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Toss the parsnips in the rest of the coconut oil and salt, and roast on a baking tray for 20-30 mins until browned. Scatter the curry leaves over for the last 5 mins, if using. Toss the parsnips in the dressing and pile onto a platter, scattered with the cashews.
